scope: Development-source Rust synchronous keyboard provider with isolated ProtoInput facts adapter, existing Ouroboros Native controls workflow and MCP initial_keyboard/routing_input. Virtual input and explicitly owned disposable processes only.

build_evidence.checks: cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace; default x64/i686 app+observer builds; x64/x86 native backend builds
build_evidence.reuse: All six commands passed in raw attempt002. Its aggregate remains FAIL for one new C++ header LF-to-CRLF normalization. Completion001 separately verifies equivalent source and reused successful outputs, then stages fresh matching private/MAIN runtimes.

owned_accelerator.accepted: Exactly one Ctrl-down/S-down/S-up/Ctrl-up sequence, consumed TranslateAcceleratorW, one WM_COMMAND 0x7A51 notification1/source0 at owned root, unchanged SEED, clean release/Stop/EOF/WM_CLOSE.

wordpad.accepted: Two original x64 classic WordPad processes: independent A-one/B-one text and native RichEdit focus, idle retention, -two without re-click, one genuine virtual Ctrl+S per user, exact separate persisted A-one-two/B-one-two RTF bodies, clean normal Stop/EOF/WM_CLOSE.
wordpad.placement: Only freshly owned roots were made topmost without activation; exact geometry and owned editor hits acknowledged before input. Foreground invariance is sampled through Stop.

saved_documents.proof: Existing private RTF changed from empty baseline and contains body once; exact live RichEdit readback unchanged; no modal
